_comment: Input of pfr_runner.py for air in a heated square duct (no chemistry). python pfr_runner.py pfr_air_square.json
_case: pfr_air.json (2 m long) in a square duct of side 30 mm (hydraulic diameter 30 mm): air at 300 K, 2 bar, 50 m/s, 800 K walls, Gnielinski and Petukhov on the hydraulic diameter
_cross_section: circle (default) or square; for a square, diameter_m is the side (= the hydraulic diameter)
_wall_htc_Wm2K: a number [W/m2/K], 0 = adiabatic, or "gnielinski" (local Re and Pr, fully developed; laminar Nu 3.66)
_wall_friction: Darcy friction in the momentum equation: Petukhov, laminar 64/Re
_wall_temperature_profile: wall T(x), Main_1 knot format: position relative 0..1, 'step' holds the knot value to the next knot, 'linear' ramps to it
